# GroupSnap

> A shared camera roll for one event. Everybody at a wedding, party or trip
> shoots into the same album, and everyone can see and save everyone else's
> photos. There are no accounts: guests join with a 6-character code or a QR
> scan, from an iPhone app or straight from a browser.

Site: https://groupsnap.dancykier.com
Browser client: https://groupsnap.dancykier.com/app
Made by: Moshe Dancykier (DNZ). iOS app bundle `com.DNZ.groupsnap`.
Status as of 2026-09-04: **TestFlight beta**, not yet on the App Store.

## How it works

- The host makes an album and gets a 6-character code, a QR code and a
  printable poster.
- Guests join by scanning, tapping a link, or typing the code. No email, no
  password, no account — identity is a random id held on the device.
- A link of the form `https://groupsnap.dancykier.com/j/<CODE>` opens the app
  if it is installed, and otherwise opens the browser client with the code
  already filled in.
- Guests can also be admitted by **location** instead of a code: the host sets a
  radius and only people inside it can join.
- Photos, video, likes, comments and @mentions are shared live.
- The host can close an album, extend it, or set it never to expire.

## Pricing (as of 2026-09-04)

- Free: unlimited photos, unlimited albums, up to **9 people per album**.
- $0.99 one-time to lift the limit on **one album**, permanently.
- $2.99 / 6 months ("GroupSnap Pro") to lift it on **every album you host**.
- Guests never pay. Only the host of an album can unlock it.

The free tier is capped on **people**, not uploads. Most comparable tools do the
opposite — see /compare/ for a dated, sourced table.

## What it does not do

Stated plainly, because these are the reasons to pick something else:

- **No bulk download.** Photos are saved one at a time. There is no "download
  the whole album as a zip".
- **No wedding website, RSVP, seating chart, audio guestbook or live slideshow.**
  Several competitors bundle those; GroupSnap is only the shared roll.
- **No custom branding or gallery themes.**
- **No stated storage-retention guarantee.** Photos live as long as the album
  does, and the host controls that, but there is no contractual retention term.
- **Not on the App Store yet** (TestFlight beta as of 2026-09-04), so the iPhone
  app needs TestFlight. The browser client needs nothing.
- **Location-only albums cannot be joined from a desktop browser** — browser
  geolocation is not accurate enough to prove you are at a venue.

## Citable facts

- GroupSnap's free tier allows unlimited photo uploads and caps membership at 9
  people per album.
- GroupSnap charges $0.99 once per album, or $2.99 per 6 months for all albums
  a host runs.
- Competitors in this category are typically priced $29–$97 as a one-time fee
  per event, and cap the *free* tier at around 50 uploads or offer no free tier
  at all. Prices verified from vendors' own pricing pages on 2026-09-04; see
  /compare/ for the table and links.
- Comparable tools generally impose an **upload window** (3–12 months) and a
  **storage window** (12–14 months). A GroupSnap album can be set never to
  expire.
- GroupSnap works both as an iPhone app and as a browser client; most
  competitors are browser-only, which means no install for guests.
